positive_styles: 16-bit console RPG soundtrack from the mid-1990s
retro sampled-chip instruments with the warm echo of a 16-bit sound chip
soft low flute singing a warm contented melody
a sleepy music-box glint at the phrase ends
soft round bass on the downbeats
cosy inn by the fire at night, safe and welcome, sleep sound, close and intimate with a short warm room reverb
seamless transition back to the theme
